install.effects: Frozen dependency installation with the pinned pnpm and lockfile.

setup.effects: Builds Lamp, migrates local data, saves private settings, claims the first owner through Base operator-auth and initializes product settings.

dev.effects: Serves Lamp locally with Base keyed owner dev identity and silently suppressed mail.

preview.effects: Serves the fixed production build locally. Sign in locally with rer dev.

build.effects: Builds the production Worker and assets with private local settings set aside.

verify.effects: Runs Lamp's complete local verification: source, Workers, browser and generated-artifact checks; no hosted acceptance claim.

reset.effects: After confirmation removes local data, owner, generated private settings and installer state; keeps source, exports and deployment receipts.

deploy.effects: Runs Lamp's Cloudflare pipeline: input validation, resource setup and migrations, build, secret upload, Worker deploy and health check. Full verification runs separately with rer verify. --dry-run builds and validates locally with no provider request.

export.effects: Writes the local D1 data and R2 snapshots to a new owner-only archive with an integrity receipt. node scripts/export.mjs --remote covers a deployed installation.

import.effects: Restores a verified archive into an empty local installation after --yes. node scripts/setup.mjs --restore-from covers a deployed installation.

release.effects: Base release producer: receipts, validation and gates; never pushes or deploys.

doctor.effects: Read-only tool, configuration and state diagnostics naming missing inputs.

describe.effects: Describes commands, flags, pins and local state without running project commands.

authentication.deployment: Owner-controlled Cloudflare API token and account ID.
authentication.operators: Base operator-auth native email links with a confirmation POST; optional owner-linked OpenID Connect; keyed local owner identity in development.

health.semantics: Dependency health, answered on the app host and the page host; local input checks never assert deployed health.

environmentSources.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: Deploy guide step 2: the Account ID shown in Workers and Pages in the Cloudflare dashboard
environmentSources.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: Deploy guide step 2: an API token with Workers Scripts, D1, Workers R2 Storage and Queues set to Edit
environmentSources.LAMP_PAGE_HOST: Deploy guide step 3: the address your customers read your status page at
environmentSources.LAMP_APP_HOST: Deploy guide step 3: the address you and your team sign in at
environmentSources.LAMP_PAGE_NAME: Deploy guide step 4: your status page name
environmentSources.LAMP_PAGE_TAGLINE: Deploy guide step 4: one sentence shown under the page name
environmentSources.LAMP_PAGE_TIMEZONE: Deploy guide step 4: the time zone your page shows times in, such as Europe/London
environmentSources.LAMP_ACCENT_COLOR: Deploy guide step 4: your brand colour as # and six hex digits
environmentSources.SETUP_OPERATOR_EMAIL: Deploy guide step 5: your own email address; you become the page owner
environmentSources.SUBSCRIBER_TOKEN_SECRET: Generate a private random subscriber signing value
environmentSources.WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET: Generate a private random webhook signing value
environmentSources.SETUP_TOKEN: Generate a private random one-time setup value
environmentSources.SESSION_SECRET: Generate and preserve a private random session signing value
